It offers a good balance of features and performance at a slightly higher asking price. But with several better premium devices available at a lower price, it might not find any takers just yet.

description: Xiaomi Clip has been introduced with an open-ear clip-on design, 11mm dynamic drivers, LHDC 5.0 audio support, and Hi-Res Audio Wireless certification. Xiaomi has added AI-powered tools such as transcription, translation, recording, and XiaoAI conversational features. The earbuds also support Apple Find My, Bluetooth 5.4, dual-device connectivity, IP57 water resistance, and offer up to 38 hours of total battery life with the charging case.
title: Xiaomi Clip Open-Ear Earbuds Launched With LHDC 5.0 Audio, Up to 38 Hours Total Battery Life: Price, Specifications

description: After book-style foldables, smartphone manufacturers are now moving towards wide-folding smartphones. Samsung has been rumoured to launch the purported Galaxy Z Wide Fold alongside the Galaxy Z Fold 8 this year, while Apple’s first-ever foldable iPhone is also believed to be one such device. According to a tipster, an unidentified manufacturer is testing a wide-foldable handset powered by Qualcomm’s upcoming Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6-series. It is believed to be an upcoming foldable phone from Honor.
title: Honor Developing Wide-Foldable Phone With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 SoC, Tipster Claims

description: The Oppo Find X9s, Vivo X300 FE, and OnePlus 15 compete in India's premium smartphone segment with flagship hardware, AMOLED displays, and large batteries. The Oppo handset offers Hasselblad-backed cameras and a 7,025mAh battery, while the Vivo X300 FE combines a Zeiss-tuned camera system with long software support and up to 5,000 nits peak brightness. Meanwhile, the OnePlus 15 features a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, 165Hz display, 7,300mAh battery, and 120W charging, making it the most powerful option on paper.
title: Oppo Find X9s vs Vivo X300 FE vs OnePlus 15: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro smartwatch launched in China with several health tracking features. It has a 1.74-inch AMOLED colour display with up to 2000 nits peak brightness. It is advertised to offer up to 21 days of battery life on a single charge. It has a dual-light PPD sensor and offers blood oxygen saturation monitoring. It has a 5ATM water resistance rating and offers more than 200 watch faces.
title: Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro Launched With 1.74-Inch AMOLED Screen, Up to 21 Days Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Xiaomi 17 Max has been launched in China. The new handset was unveiled during the tech giant’s May 2026 event, which also witnessed the debut of the Xiaomi YU7 GT, Xiaomi Band 10 Pro, and Xiaomi Ear Clip TWS. The Xiaomi 17 Max joins the Xiaomi 17, Xiaomi 17 Pro, Xiaomi 17 Pro Max, and the flagship Xiaomi 17 Ultra. The phone is powered by the same chipset that powers other handsets in the series, the octa core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC. The Xiaomi 17 Max also features a Leica-tuned triple rear camera setup, led by a 200-megapixel primary shooter.
title: Xiaomi 17 Max Launched With 8,000mAh Battery, Leica-Tuned 200-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Google is trying hard to turn Gemini into a super app that can handle not only different tasks, but tasks in different apps and platforms. The Mountain View-based tech giant is achieving this through the underlying artificial intelligence (AI) models’ agentic capabilities and third-party connectors. The first allows the chatbot to take actions via external tools, and the second allows Gemini access to third-party data hubs and platforms.
title: Google’s Gemini Offers Agentic Design Creation With New Adobe and Canva Connectors

description: Oppo Find X9 Ultra launched in the Indian market with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and Hasselblad-branded quad rear camera setup, and 7,050mAh battery with support for 100W wired fast charging and 50W wireless charging. It has an IP66+IP68 + IP69-rated build for dust and water resistance. Let's compare the Oppo Find X9 Ultra price in India and specifications with those of the Vivo X300 Ultra to know the key differences between the three new smartphones.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra vs Vivo X300 Ultra: Which One Is Better?

description: Honor Win Turbo will launch in China next week, the company announced on Thursday. The upcoming handset has been in the rumour mill for some time now, and the brand has now revealed its design and colour options via official teasers. A tipster, meanwhile, has also shed light on some of its key specifications. The Honor Win Turbo is tipped to arrive with a 1.5K flat display and a 50-megapixel rear camera with optical image stabilisation (OIS).
title: Honor Win Turbo China Launch Date Revealed as Tipster Leaks Key Specifications

description: Vivo may soon launch the Vivo Y600 Turbo in China as a new addition to its Y600 smartphone series. A leak from a tipster suggests the handset will debut on May 25, with reservations opening on May 21 and pre-sales beginning the same day. The phone is tipped to feature a 9,020mAh Blue Ocean battery with 90W fast charging, a 6.83-inch 1.5K OLED display with a 165Hz refresh rate, a Dimensity 8500 chipset, and Android 16-based OriginOS 6.
title: Vivo Y600 Turbo Launch Date Revealed as Tipster Leaks Handset's Key Specifications

description: Sony has confirmed a price hike for PS Plus in India across Essential, Extra, and Deluxe tiers. The PlayStation parent has started sending out emails to members informing them of revised pricing. Last week, the company announced a price hike for PS Plus Essential tier in select markets.
title: Sony Hikes PS Plus Prices Across All Tiers in India: Check New Pricing

description: Vodafone Idea has expanded its 5G network in eastern India and confirmed new deployments across West Bengal and neighbouring regions. The operator has launched 5G services in Malda, Haldia, and Berhampur, while Durgapur, Asansol, Habra-Ashoknagar, Burdwan, Kharagpur, Gangtok, and Darjeeling are expected to receive coverage by June. The rollout forms part of Vi's broader plan to bring 5G services to 90 additional cities by May 2026, increasing its footprint across industrial hubs, commercial centres, and tourism-focused markets.
title: Vi Expands 5G Network in West Bengal, Plans Rollout Across 10 Cities

description: Oppo Enco Air 5 Pro has been launched in India, the tech firm announced on Thursday. The new true wireless stereo (TWS) was unveiled along with the Oppo Find X9 Ultra and the Find X9s. The Oppo Enco Air 5 Pro earphones are currently available for pre-order in the country via the Oppo India online store, and are scheduled to go on sale on May 28. The Enco Air 5 Pro is offered in Matte Black and Pearl White colour options. The TWS is claimed to offer up to 13 hours of music playback with active-noise cancellation (ANC) turned off and at 50 percent volume.
title: Oppo Enco Air 5 Pro Launched in India With Up to 54 Hours of Music Playback, 12mm Drivers: Price, Features

description: HMD Vibe 2 5G has been launched in India with a 6,000mAh battery. The new HMD phone is currently available for purchase in India through Flipkart in three colour options. It is offered in two RAM and storage options, and it runs on an octa-core chipset. It includes a 6.7-inch HD+ display and a 50-megapixel primary rear camera with LED flash support.
title: HMD Vibe 2 5G Launched in India With 6,000mAh Battery, Up to 128GB Storage: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung is once again rumoured to shake up its next-generation flagship Galaxy S lineup. In 2025, the South Korean tech conglomerate replaced the Plus model with the Galaxy S25 Edge. However, low sales volume and other factors caused the company to bring back the Galaxy S26+ this year. According to a report, Samsung is developing a Galaxy S27 Pro model that may join the standard Galaxy S27, Galaxy S27+, and Galaxy S27 Ultra.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro With 6.47-Inch Display Reportedly in Development; Could Join Galaxy S27 Lineup Next Year

description: Google AI Studio, over the years, has become a fun place for developers and artificial intelligence (AI) enthusiasts to test out new models and features, or to build vibe-coded apps using application programming interface (API) keys. But now the Mountain View-based tech giant is increasing its usability and targeting general users with a new development.
title: Google Is Bringing AI Studio to Android Smartphones, Will Let Users Vibe Code Apps

description: Vivo S60 will be launched in China in three colour options, the tech firm announced on Thursday. The three colourways will be marketed as Early Summer Green, Midsummer Night's Dream (black), and Sea of ​​Stars (white) (translated from Chinese). This comes days after the smartphone maker announced that the Vivo S60, its latest S series smartphone, will be unveiled in China on May 29. The handset is confirmed to be equipped with a 7,200mAh battery, with support for 90W wired fast charging via a USB Type-C port.
title: Vivo S60 Colour Options Revealed Days Ahead of Launch in China: Expected Specifications, Features

description: Oppo revealed the rear camera specifications of the Oppo Reno 16 series. Both Oppo Reno 16 and Reno 16 are confirmed to come with a 200-megapixel main camera. Additionally, a leak claimed that Oppo will release the Reno 16 series in India this July. The company could launch four Reno 16 series smartphones in the Indian market. The Reno 16 series launch is scheduled for May 25.
title: Oppo Reno 16, Reno 16 Pro Rear Camera Details Teased as Details of India Launch Timeline Surface Online

description: Vivo S2 will reportedly launch in India in July. The handset could be priced between Rs. 45,000 and Rs. 50,000 in India. It will reportedly be a photography-focused handset. It could offer a slim and lightweight build. The Vivo S2 is expected to succeed the Vivo S1, which was launched in 2019. It could come with camera-centric features.
title: Vivo S Series Tipped to Return to India With New Vivo S2; Launch Timeline, Price Range Leaked

description: Poco has unveiled the Poco Pad C1 tablet with a 9.7-inch 2K 120Hz display, Snapdragon 6s 4G Gen 2 chipset, and a 7,600mAh battery. The tablet supports up to 6GB RAM, 128GB storage, and up to 2TB expandable storage via MicroSD card. It ships with Xiaomi HyperOS 3 based on Android 16 and includes stereo speakers, AI face unlock, and USB Type-C connectivity. The Poco Pad C1 also features an all-metal unibody design, dual cameras, and support for Wi-Fi 5 and Bluetooth 5.0.
title: Poco Pad C1 Unveiled With Snapdragon 6s 4G Gen 2 Chip, 7,600mAh Battery

description: Oppo Find X10 series will be launched with a significantly larger battery than its predecessor, a tipster claims. The rumoured Oppo Find X10 lineup is said to be backed by an 8,000mAh battery or a larger cell. For reference, the Oppo Find X9 and Oppo Find X9s pack a 7,025mAh battery. Meanwhile, the flagship Oppo Find X9 Ultra is equipped with a 7,050mAh cell. On the other hand, the Oppo Find X9 Pro is backed by the largest battery in the lineup, boasting a 7,500mAh cell. However, the company has yet to confirm these details.
title: Oppo Find X10 Series Leak Hints at a Notable Battery Upgrade Over Find X9 Lineup

description: The Oppo Find X9 Ultra was launched in India on Thursday as the top-of-the-line model in the flagship Find X9 lineup. Debuting alongside the Find X9s, it joins the existing Oppo Find X9 and Find X9 Pro models in the country. The handset is powered by a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, coupled with 16GB of RAM. It is equipped with a quad rear camera unit co-developed with Hasselblad. The Oppo Find X9 Ultra packs a 7,050mAh silicon-carbon battery with 100W wired fast charging.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Launched in India With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, Dual 200-Megapixel Hasselblad-Tuned Cameras: Price, Features

description: Oppo Find X9s has been launched in India as the latest addition to the company’s flagship Find X9 lineup. The handset is offered in Lavender Sky, Midnight Grey, and Sunset Orange colour options. The base variant features 12GB of RAM and 256GB of onboard storage. The Oppo Find X9s arrives with an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 9500s chipset. The handset carries a Hasselblad-tuned triple rear camera system, led by a 50-megapixel primary shooter, along with a 50-megapixel ultrawide camera and a 50-megapixel periscope telephoto camera. It packs a 7,025mAh battery.
title: Oppo Find X9s Launched in India With Hasselblad-Tuned 50-Megapixel Cameras, 7,025mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Sony has announced a new State of Play broadcast for next month. The company's games showcase event returns on June 2. State of Play will be broadcast live across YouTube and Twitch. The livestream is confirmed to bring an extended new look at Marvel's Wolverine gameplay.
title: State of Play Broadcast Returns on June 2, Featuring New Look at Marvel's Wolverine Gameplay

description: Warhorse Studios, the developer of Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2, has revealed two new projects. The Czech studio is working on an open-world Middle-earth RPG and a new Kingdom Come adventure. Warhorse said it would reveal more details about the two games in the future.
title: Warhorse Studios Announces Open-World Middle-Earth RPG and New Kingdom Come Adventure

description: Vivo X500 series will be launched in China earlier than its predecessor did last year, according to a report. The lineup is expected to initially include the Vivo X500, Vivo X500 Pro, and Vivo X500 Pro Max, unlike last year’s Vivo X300 series, which initially comprised Vivo X300 and Vivo X300 Pro. The Vivo X500 Pro Max will reportedly be backed by an 8,000mAh battery, which could be the largest among the lot. Moreover, the Pro Max model will reportedly be powered by the unreleased octa core MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, which could be built on a 2nm process, like Samsung’s Exynos 2600 SoC.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Max Chipset and Battery Details Leaked; Could Arrive With Largest Battery in the Vivo X500 Lineup

description: This Android 17 will come with a Continue On feature. It is a cross-device continuity tool that is designed to let users start work in an app on one Android device and continue the same task on another device within their Android ecosystem. The company has shared videos demonstrating the Continue On feature. Google's Continue On update appears to be similar to Apple's Handoff. At launch, the feature will initially support transitions between smartphones and tablets.
title: Android 17 to Introduce 'Continue On' Feature That Lets Users Resume Apps Across Phones, Tablets

description: Samsung has announced its 2026 Odyssey gaming monitor lineup and new ViewFinity S8 series globally. The range includes the Odyssey G8 G80HS with a 6K 165Hz display, the Odyssey G8 G80HF with 5K resolution, and the Odyssey OLED G8 with a 4K 240Hz QD-OLED panel. Samsung also introduced the Odyssey OLED G7 and refreshed ViewFinity S8 models with Thunderbolt 5 and 5K display options. The monitors support DisplayPort 2.1, HDR10+ Gaming, AMD FreeSync Premium, and Nvidia G-Sync Compatible technologies.
title: Samsung Odyssey G8 6K Monitor Announced Alongside New Odyssey OLED G7 and ViewFinity S8 Monitors

description: Apple on Thursday announced the arrival of two of its biggest health-focused features in India. The Cupertino-based tech giant says it has received regulatory approval to roll out Sleep Apnea Notifications on supported Apple Watch models and the Hearing Test feature on AirPods Pro in the country. Both features are designed to help address major health challenges, including undiagnosed sleep apnea and hearing loss. The features, however, are still said to maintain user privacy through on-device processing and encrypted health records.
title: Apple’s Big Health Move in India: Watch Gets Sleep Apnea Alerts, AirPods Pro Gain Hearing Test Feature

description: CMF is rumoured to be developing the successor to the CMF Phone 2 Pro, which was unveiled in April last year. While the company has yet to confirm any details about the purported handset, a tipster has now shared some details. As per the claim, the CMF Phone 2 Pro may not arrive as early as expected, with its debut now tipped for the third quarter of 2026. The leak also reveals several key specifications of the phone, including its chipset, display, cameras, battery capacity, and charging capabilities.
title: CMF Phone 3 Pro May Launch Later Than Previously Anticipated; Key Specifications Tipped
